    steps:

          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up build environment
        run: nix develop --command just init
      - name: Test build recipe
        run: nix develop --command just build planck
      - name: Test draw recipe
        run: nix develop --command just draw",
  "rationale": "Adds a top-level concurrency group with cancel-in-progress (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) so that when a new push starts a workflow run on the same branch, in-progress jobs from the previous run are canceled. No new actions, secrets, permissions, or network access are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
